probedOn: the kit's human rig (lib/figures.js CLIPS), side view contact sheets (rig-pose proof ?probe=clipA,clipB&pry=1.57&pstep=.3), 2026-10-14

clips.KK_Digging_Loop: barely bends: knees bend, the back stays upright. For digging use Walk_Loop + hinge .85-1.0 + lean .3 (pose.recon.shovel-digger).
clips.Push_Loop: crouched with the arms OVERHEAD, not forward. For pushing use Walk_Loop t 0 + tilt .45 + hinge .22 (pose.recon.cart-pusher).
clips.Walk_Loop: t 0 is the widest stride (a good planted stance for push/dig); .1 and .75 are usable dig stances.
clips.KK_Sit_Floor_Idle_Loop: legs out in front, hands near the hips; t .3 reads well for reading on the floor.
clips.KK_Crawl_Loop: at t 0 the root floats the pelvis .6 m above the floor.
clips.ClimbUp_1m: crouches the spine: the climber came out 25% too short. Use Idle_Loop + footTo + handTo (pose.recon.rope-climber).
clips.Swim_Fwd_Loop: a flat prone body: lower it to the floor and turn the spine up (pose.recon.prone-crawler).
clips.Fixing_Kneeling: a kneel with the hands working low; t 1 + spine turns gives all fours over a hole.
clips.Idle_Loop: neutral standing base for foot/hand IK poses.
clips.Sitting_Talking_Loop / Sitting_Idle_Loop: seated, need act({ seat }) (the clips sit on a .45 m seat scaled by height / 1.8).
clips.sit clips at 1.2x scale: put the hips about .4 m behind the figure origin: adjust seat / placement.

rules: Clip names don't predict silhouettes: probe first (one render).
Roots carry offsets: check bone heights numerically (?bones=1) before trusting a clip.
act({ seat }) re-seats every tick: group y offsets are ignored for seated clips.
